items.question: What validity periods can a jobseeker visit visa in the UAE have?
items.fact: Jobseeker visit visa validity is 60, 90 or 120 days

items.question: How many years ago at most must a graduate have graduated to qualify for a UAE jobseeker visit visa via the top-500-universities route?
items.fact: Top-500-university graduates must have graduated within last 2 years
